messages:
Maya: Quick sync — can we prioritize a 2-panel heatmap (latency vs $/1k tokens) + a callout for tail latency for the webinar? Need a deck by Tues. Mock: https://drive.redwood/infer/heatmap-v1.png
Andre: +1. Show median and p99 separately. Audience will ask p99 first. Also add hosted vs dedicated routing comparison.
Sam: Proposed axes: x = latency (ms), y = cost ($ per 1k tokens). Color = throughput tier. I can sketch in Figma.
Zoe: Headline idea: "Latency where it matters, cost when it counts" — strong claim, keep methodology as small print.
BenchBot: Auto-bench summary uploaded: median 80ms -> 60ms; p99 420ms -> 160ms; cost $/1k tokens 3.2 -> 2.1. Full CSV below.
Andre: Add a small table under the chart: sample prompt lengths, token counts, batching config. People will ask config details.
Maya: Two CTAs: 1) Request Dedicated trial 2) View methodology. Route 1 -> sales/webinar signup, 2 -> docs. Who owns routing?
ProductOps: I'll wire inbound: webinar signups -> marketing leads queue; methodology clicks -> docs bucket. Tag leads with \"bench-webinar-heatmap\" for follow-up.
Sam: Slide order suggestion: 1) problem (latency vs cost), 2) measurement methodology, 3) heatmap & callouts, 4) real-world scenarios, 5) routing options + CTAs.
Zoe: Copy note: avoid "cheaper" — prefer "lower unit cost". Add caveat about model variants and quantization in notes.
Maya: Action items: Sam — Figma mock by EOD Fri. Andre — p99 callouts and numbers. ProductOps — inbound routing draft. BenchBot — upload full CSV and run metadata. I'll consolidate for Tues.
Andre: ack. Methodology snippet to include in docs/slide notes:
```json
{"model":"redwood-v1","seq_len":1024,"batching":"dynamic","quant":"int8"}
```
Sam: Will embed that in slide notes and the methodology page. :thumbsup:
Zoe: I'm A/B testing two email headlines: 1) "Benchmark: get speed without the surprise" 2) "Cut token spend, keep latency tight" — leaning toward 1.
Maya: Nice. Add utm_content=heatmap_v1 to all links.
BenchBot: CSV uploaded: https://bench.redwood/runs/1777777777.csv
ProductOps: Routing draft: https://confluence.redwood/bench-routing-draft — pinged Sales for lead qual rules.
Maya: Cool, I'll pull everything into the deck and circulate Monday afternoon for review.
